appliesTo: future full-pool rescoring; does not alter committed v1.2 artifacts

networkingRelevance.passRule: Explicit supplied evidence must show that the company sells, distributes, specifies, buys, designs, installs, deploys, operates or maintains active networking hardware, or implements WLAN/LAN projects that directly require it.
activeEquipmentExamples: wireless AP, mesh or WLAN controller
network firewall, security gateway or network-management controller
acceptableEvidence: explicit WLAN/LAN design, specification, BOM, procurement, deployment or maintenance
insufficientAlone: structured cabling, fiber or low-voltage work
networkingRelevance.pureCablingBoundary: A pure cabling company may be a valid Installer but fails this Cudy relevance gate without active-equipment evidence.
networkingRelevance.unknownHandling: Missing public proof is not demonstrated, not confirmed factual irrelevance; not demonstrated fails the benchmark gate.
networkingRelevance.separateFitDimension: Passing the gate does not imply high Cudy product/use-case fit.
